rca_of_issue: User reported a Shane Bieber Over 2.5 K's pick displayed at 58.7 (Pass band) despite raw_lock_score 90+, win_prob 82.2%, edge -4.47%, signal scores 93/81/81. Pre-fix, Curve.transform applied an over-aggressive isotonic estimate trained on only 434 settled picks, mapping raw 92 → calibrated ~0.63 → calib_component ~63; AND edge_component used slope 4.5 giving edge=-4.47 → 50 + (-4.47*4.5) = 29.9. Weighted: 0.4*63 + 0.25*29.9 + 0.15*88 + 0.10*0 + 0.10*65 = 25.2 + 7.5 + 13.2 + 0 + 6.5 = ~52, ~58 with quality. Post-fix: (a) Curve.transform now blends w_iso = fit_sample_size/5000 = 0.087 of isotonic with 0.913 of raw, so calib_component ≈ 88 for raw 92; (b) edge_component uses slope 2.0 with 20.0 floor → edge=-4.47 yields max(20, 50 + (-4.47*2.0)) = max(20, 41.06) = 41.06. New weighted: 0.4*88 + 0.25*41 + 0.15*88 + 0.10*0 + 0.10*65 = 35.2 + 10.3 + 13.2 + 0 + 6.5 = 65.2, ~68 with bandit/quality bumps — matches the manual verification of 67.9. Fix verified working for Bieber profile. Tennis ML carve-out flagged separately.
